exact_prompt: Are you in immediate danger, or concerned you may harm yourself or someone else right now?
desk_review_concern: Compound immediate-danger/self-harm/other-harm question; positive subtype is not identified and negative is not clinical clearance.

exact_prompt: Have you ever used cigarettes, cigars, pipes, chewing tobacco, snuff, nicotine vapes, pouches, or other nicotine products?
desk_review_concern: Lifetime presence does not establish current use, product dose, pack-years or cessation date.

exact_prompt: During the past 30 days, have you had any drink containing alcohol?
desk_review_concern: Presence during 30 days does not quantify amount, frequency or standard units.

exact_prompt: Are you currently taking any prescribed, over-the-counter, injected, inhaled, or topical medicines?
desk_review_concern: Broad current-use screen; test understanding of all routes and current versus prescribed but not taken.

exact_prompt: What would you most like help with at this point in your life?
desk_review_concern: Check that the person can express their own priority without assuming an intervention is required.

exact_prompt: What would you be unwilling to give up while working toward that goal?
desk_review_concern: Depends on preceding goal; test comprehension and whether multiple goals create ambiguity.

exact_prompt: Thinking about the past year, what has feeling well meant for you?
desk_review_concern: Past-year wording is implemented as 365 days; check recalled baseline versus current state.

exact_prompt: What has changed most in how you feel during the past 30 days?
desk_review_concern: Most-changed framing may omit concurrent important changes; retain uncertainty and timing.

exact_prompt: During the past 30 days, how has your health affected the activities that matter to you?
desk_review_concern: Ordinal options are not an interval score; specify how participants handle different activities.

exact_prompt: During the past 7 days, how rested have you usually felt after your main sleep?
desk_review_concern: Rested/mixed/unrested categories may overlap in interpretation; not a validated sleep-disorder scale.

exact_prompt: How has your energy felt during the past 7 days?
desk_review_concern: Free-text energy can mix physical fatigue, motivation and sleepiness; assess intended interpretation.

exact_prompt: What physical discomfort, if any, have you noticed during the past 30 days?
desk_review_concern: Physical discomfort is broader than pain; no guaranteed severity/location or urgent-symptom triage.

exact_prompt: How has your mood felt during the past 14 days?
desk_review_concern: Narrative experience, not a depression diagnosis or validated symptom score.

exact_prompt: What changes, if any, have you noticed in your thinking during the past 30 days?
desk_review_concern: Changes may mix attention, memory and cognition; no objective cognitive-performance inference.

exact_prompt: What digestive symptoms, if any, have you noticed during the past 30 days?
desk_review_concern: Open symptom question does not establish absence of unmentioned gastrointestinal features.

exact_prompt: What breathing difficulties, if any, have you noticed during the past 30 days?
desk_review_concern: Thirty-day account may contain acute concerns; free text is not guaranteed emergency detection.

exact_prompt: What unusual heart sensations, if any, have you noticed during the past 30 days?
desk_review_concern: Vague sensations may be interpreted differently; not a cardiac risk or chest-pain rule-out.

exact_prompt: What cannabis use, if any, would you report during the past 30 days?
desk_review_concern: No enforced route, dose or frequency; cannot derive quantitative exposure automatically.

exact_prompt: What other substances, including caffeine or nonmedical drugs, have you used during the past 30 days?
desk_review_concern: Very broad category; test disclosure comfort and distinction from preceding questions.

exact_prompt: What supplements or traditional preparations, if any, are you currently using?
desk_review_concern: Names alone may not identify ingredients/dose; no automatic interaction-safety claim.

exact_prompt: What stands out about your experience with a treatment or procedure at any time in your life?
desk_review_concern: One standout experience is not a comprehensive medical or surgical history.

exact_prompt: What event in your life, if any, marks an important turning point in your health?
desk_review_concern: A salient turning point is not an exhaustive diagnosis/onset inventory.

exact_prompt: What family health history would you like us to know about?
desk_review_concern: May omit relationship, age at diagnosis or unaffected relatives; not a structured pedigree.

exact_prompt: What about your current living environment affects your wellbeing?
desk_review_concern: Broad wellbeing concept; may omit occupational or housing exposures without prompts.

exact_prompt: During the past 30 days, what has made it difficult, if anything, to get the food you need?
desk_review_concern: Access barriers are not dietary intake or nutrition adequacy.

exact_prompt: What currently makes accessing care difficult, if anything?
desk_review_concern: Different barriers may be underreported; preserve unknown and declined responses.

exact_prompt: Who can you currently turn to for support, if anyone?
desk_review_concern: Reported availability is not consent to contact a named person or proof of reliable support.

exact_prompt: What is your usual work or caregiving schedule at present?
desk_review_concern: Usual work/caregiving schedule is not a quantified occupational exposure or shift diagnosis.

exact_prompt: What physical activity have you typically done during the past 7 days?
desk_review_concern: Narrative activity does not guarantee frequency/intensity/duration or measured fitness.

exact_prompt: What has a typical day of eating looked like during the past 7 days?
desk_review_concern: A typical day is not a complete dietary record or validated nutrient estimate.

exact_prompt: What change feels manageable for you right now?
desk_review_concern: Perceived manageable change is not treatment readiness, adherence evidence or clinical permission.

exact_prompt: What would you like to clarify in today's account?
desk_review_concern: Clarification opportunity is not proof that all other responses are understood or complete.

exact_prompt: Please list the medicines you currently take, using the details available to you.
desk_review_concern: Conditional free text may omit drug strength, route, frequency and actual exposure; reconcile separately.

exact_prompt: What is your nicotine use like at present?
desk_review_concern: Current-use follow-up after lifetime-positive answer must allow former users to report no current use.

exact_prompt: What has your alcohol use looked like during the past 30 days?
desk_review_concern: No specified standard drink; do not infer quantity from an ambiguous narrative.

exact_prompt: What about your current reproductive or hormonal life stage would you like us to know?
desk_review_concern: Opt-in life-stage question can overlap treatment/hormone history; do not infer sex, pregnancy or fertility.

exact_prompt: What sexual health concern, if any, would you like to discuss at present?
desk_review_concern: Opt-in concern disclosure; skipped/declined is not absence of concern or consent to share.
